Class SocketBase

java.lang.Object
com.alexswd.top.network.tcp.SocketBase
All Implemented Interfaces:
ISocket
Direct Known Subclasses:
PlainSocket, TorSocket
public class SocketBase extends Object implements ISocket
Base implementation of the ISocket interface.

This class provides a delegating implementation that wraps a Socket. All methods are delegated to the underlying socket instance.

Since:
1.0
